rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for a cruel ruler and can also describe an abusive person who has authority, such as a boss or official.

example.english: That tyrant abuses his power all the time, leaving the people afraid to speak out.
example.traditional: 嗰個暴君成日濫用權力，搞到啲百姓敢怒唔敢言。
